QuestInfo.name: [[KMS 2016 NY Event]][Starlight Festival Season 14] Get Both Star Stamp and Get Star Box!
QuestInfo.0:
[[KMS 2016 NY Event]]There is a Star Box event along with the Starlight Festival! You will get a Star Box when you get at least 5 Star Stamps every day! You will also get a Special Star Box every time you get 3, 6, and 9 Star Boxes!
#bThis quest can only be done by one character.#k#n
